contentPage.heroTitle: Turn one product brief into a usable promo draft in the same session.
contentPage.heroBody: This first studio version keeps the workflow tight for affiliate execution: one offer, one angle, one clear CTA, and a draft the team can immediately review or duplicate.
contentPage.modeSelectorTitle: Choose how the studio should work
contentPage.modeSelectorBody: Start with the level of control that feels right. The engine stays the same, only the guidance changes.
contentPage.sessionStateFresh: A new draft will autosave in this browser while you shape the brief.
contentPage.sessionStateRestored: Your last progress was restored from the previous session at {{savedAt}}.
contentPage.studioFlowBody: Work through one stage at a time. The same session keeps all of the data, but the layout is now more focused so it feels easier to follow.

studioSteps.label: Mode entry
studioSteps.body: Choose how the studio should work

studioSteps.body: Fill in the core product context

studioSteps.label: Review & approve
studioSteps.body: Check the script and video plan

studioSteps.label: Render result
studioSteps.body: Track the render and publish state

mode.title: Choose the working style that feels right
mode.body: Start from the control level that matches you best. The engine stays the same, but the flow is now split into focused stages.

brief.title: Capture the core context first
brief.body: Focus on the few inputs that matter most for a usable draft. Advanced fields still exist, but they no longer crowd the main step.

review.title: Check the draft before rendering
review.body: The script, scene plan, and validation state now sit in a single review stage so you do not have to jump across unrelated cards.

templates.title: Choose an official or workspace template
templates.body: Use a template to speed up the brief, or manage workspace versions when your team needs its own formula.

render.title: Track the final output in one place
render.body: The video preview, poster, publish account, and handoff status are now gathered into one clearer final stage.

workflowModes.title: Quick
workflowModes.body: AI helps from brief to first draft, with one short checkpoint before it moves ahead.

workflowModes.title: Assisted
workflowModes.body: AI suggests and drafts, but you still approve the important decisions along the way.

workflowModes.title: Manual
workflowModes.body: You keep full control. Best for operators or teams that already have their own formula.

contentPage.playbookBody: Keep the first affiliate batch narrow so the team can learn faster.

playbooks.title: Lead with the buyer pain
playbooks.body: Open with the specific frustration that makes the product feel urgent, not with a feature list.

playbooks.title: One offer per draft
playbooks.body: Avoid stacking multiple promos in the same script. Each draft should carry one clean conversion thesis.

playbooks.title: Keep the CTA direct
playbooks.body: For affiliate flow, the ending should push one action only: click, check, or compare now.

contentPage.generatorBody: Start with the minimum context needed to generate a first promo draft and video plan.

quick.title: We will capture this brief first before AI moves into the first draft.
quick.body: Best for sellers who want speed without losing the core context.

assisted.title: AI helps assemble the draft, while you keep the important review moments.
assisted.body: This is the default because it balances speed and control the best.

manual.title: Core inputs stay with you, and AI only helps when you ask for it.
manual.body: Best for agency workflows, operators, or more precise experimentation.

contentPage.advancedBody: Keep these optional at first. The studio can already plan a usable video from the core brief.

contentPage.workflowBody: A simple sequence so the first batch can move from idea to publish without too much friction.

workflowItems.title: Lock the offer
workflowItems.body: Choose one promo hook: payday price, voucher, social proof, or urgency. Avoid mixing them all in one draft.

workflowItems.title: Generate the first draft
workflowItems.body: Use the brief form to create the initial hook, body copy, and CTA that the team can react to quickly.

workflowItems.title: Duplicate what wins
workflowItems.body: When one line feels sharp, clone it into the next batch instead of rewriting from zero.
